questions.explanation_english: it / that. Demonstrative pronouns in direct speech undergo functional adjustments during indirect conversion based on context. When ‘this’ refers to a specific physical object nearby, it shifts to ‘that’. However, when ‘this’ refers to an abstract idea, situation, or broad concept rather than a concrete entity, it is commonly rendered as ‘it’ or ‘that’ in indirect narration to ensure natural text cohesion.

key_facts: Demonstrative pronouns change based on context in indirect speech.
